annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Council Regulation amending Council Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 on establishing the European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (AI Gigafactories and quantum technologies)
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Council Regulation amending Council Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 on establishing the European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (AI Gigafactories and quantum technologies)
annotation.summary_en: Commission proposal (COM(2025) 414) to amend the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking Regulation so it can fund and oversee AI Gigafactories (ultra-scale AI compute facilities) and a quantum technologies pillar. It sets consortium eligibility, EU funding (up to 17% of CAPEX), access-time rules and strategic-interest safeguards. It has no robotics or embodied-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines AI Gigafactory, consortium, coordinator and hosting agreement; adds new Article 12b.
EU contribution covers up to 17% of AI Gigafactory compute CAPEX, with matching by Participating States.
Restricts non-EU participation to protect Union strategic assets, security and autonomy.
Creates a Quantum Technologies pillar and a Quantum Strategy Advisory Group.
Raises the EU contribution ceiling to EUR 3.97 billion, with additional funds reallocated from Horizon Europe, Digital Europe and CEF.
